headings.text: Build Confidence Speaking English (Even If You Make Mistakes)

paragraphs: Fear, not grammar, is the real blocker. Practical mindset shifts to speak more and worry less.
Most learners know enough words but stay silent from fear.
Every fluent speaker made errors for years. Native kids take 5 years to speak well. You are ahead.
You do not need perfect English. You need clear English. "Where is station?" works.
For shops, office, calls — keep 5 ready sentences. Confidence comes from preparation.
SpeakNow lets you practise alone, no judgement. Build up, then talk to people.
Ordered tea in English? That is a win. Note it.
Each day, do one thing in English you normally do in Hindi. A shop, a call, a post. Fear shrinks with use.
Free browser-based English speaking practice. No downloads, no sign-ups, no data leaving your computer.
